newsitem.title: USA: ANR shuts gas platform due U.S. Gulf storm.
newsitem.headline: ANR shuts gas platform due U.S. Gulf storm.

text.p: ANR Pipeline Co said Monday it evacuated its High Island Offshore System (HIOS) Block 264 located offshore Texas in the Gulf of Mexico over the weekend as a precaution ahead of Tropical Storm Josephine.
The evacuations shut in about 150 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of the total 950 mmcfd of production, a company spokesman said.
Crews are expected to return to the offshore Texas facility later today, he said.
At ANR's Eugene Island Block 188, there were no evacuations, but compressors were shut off due to the shut in production.
The company spokesman could not comment on what volumes had been shut in on this offshore Louisiana platform.
"Everything should be back to normal by tomorrow," he said.
ANR Pipeline is a unit of Coastal Corp.
